note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is a key-bag with five distinct key sets across the 3456 published records: 2800 carry only `{factory, generator, round}`, so the datasets-server infers that thin shape from the first shard and then cannot cast the later records that add up to nine more keys, which leaves `viewer` / `search` / `filter` / `statistics` false on `/is-valid` even though the streaming preview works. `reward` (five key sets) and `tool_call.args` (keys per tool) vary the same way, so the union is declared on the card rather than rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on all 3456 records and never empty; mandatory here, unlike the sibling `long-horizon-coding-trajectories` declaration where `plan` is optional

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`command`, `path`, `old`, `new`, `contents`, `pattern`, `url`, `args`), so no single struct fits

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag with five key sets: `success`, `tests_passed` and `cost_steps` on all 3456 records, `plan_changes` on 3448, `handoff` and `xfailed` on 1728 each, `retries` on 4

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag with five key sets: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on all 3456 records, plus `kind` on 656, `mechanic` and `product` on 638 each, `plant` on 576, `sim_or_real` on 566, and `designed`, `domain`, `stack`, `seed` on 8

disclosures: Every one of the 3456 records is stamped `factory: cache-stampede-factory`, `generator: grok-4.6`, across rounds 1 to 1728 with no gaps and no parse failures.

387 of the 3430 `cst-*` records carry `leftover` in the record id. That is this factory's own advertised cache leftover-key mechanic, not a foreign dump and not a MIXED-kind signal; the leftover-in-id census already owns those rows.

disclosures.summary: 18 records are dest-stamped foreign leftover-mill payload: 10 GraphQL `gql-*` rows in `batch-r1405` to `batch-r1409` and 8 container-build `dbc-*-l3` rows in `batch-r1410` to `batch-r1413`. They are the 18 records this dump contributes to the 18/12/10 dest-stamped census, are kept exactly as generated, and are not re-filed here.

8 further records in `batch-r1401` to `batch-r1404` are search-index `leftover3c` templates (`sir-*`) dest-stamped to `cache-stampede-factory`. They carry the only `meta.designed` / `meta.domain` / `meta.stack` / `meta.seed` keys and the only `reward.retries` keys in the dataset. They are disclosed here rather than filed as a separate leftover-mill issue.

disclosures: `meta.kind` is not a single vocabulary: it is `designed` on 638 records, `episode` on the 8 dest-stamped `sir-*` rows, and the outcome labels `success` (5) and `partial` (5) on the 10 dest-stamped `gql-*` rows, and it is absent on 2800 records. `meta.sim_or_real` is likewise not a sim/real discriminator: its only value on all 566 records that carry it is `designed`. Both are published as generated and are readable because `meta` is declared `json`.
The 8 records whose `reward` omits `plan_changes` are all dest-stamped `dbc-*-l3` mill rows; every `cst-*` episode carries `plan_changes`.
Every one of the 50403 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields anywhere in the payload.
